title: See Next Up countdown and active show list on dashboard
description: Verifies the dashboard loads with a visible Next Up countdown and a rendered list of active shows.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify a Next Up countdown banner is displayed
Verify a list of active shows is displayed

title: View show metadata and overall progress from a show detail page
description: Verifies a user can open a show and see its metadata card (dates/venue/tags/urgency) and overall progress.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a show card in the active shows list
Verify the show metadata card is displayed
Verify the overall progress indicator is displayed

title: Open a show from dashboard to view its command center
description: Verifies clicking a show card navigates to the show detail page where metadata and progress are displayed.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a show card in the active shows list
Verify show metadata is displayed
Verify an overall progress indicator is displayed

title: Create a new show with required fields and service tags
description: Verifies creating a show with a name, move-in date, and at least one service tag navigates to the new show detail page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to add a new show
Fill "Spring Expo Automation" into the show name field
Fill a valid move-in date into the move-in date field
Select one or more service tag checkboxes
Submit the create show form
Verify show metadata is displayed
Verify the new show name "Spring Expo Automation" is visible on the show detail page

title: Sort shows by overdue to prioritize urgent work
description: Verifies selecting the overdue sort option reorders the show list to reflect urgency.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select the overdue sort order from the sort dropdown
Verify the show list order updates according to the selected sort

title: View show tasks list
description: User can open a show and view the Tasks tab with a visible list of tasks including completion status and due dates.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a show card to open its detail page
Click the Tasks tab
Verify a list of tasks is displayed with completion indicators and due dates

title: View show e-blasts list
description: User can open a show and view the E-Blasts tab with a visible list of scheduled e-blasts including sent status and dates.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a show card to open its detail page
Click the E-Blasts tab
Verify a list of e-blasts is displayed with sent indicators and scheduled dates

title: Edit show metadata and see updates reflected
description: Verifies editing show details updates the metadata shown on the command center after saving.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to add a new show
Fill "Edit Metadata Show" into the show name field
Fill a valid move-in date into the move-in date field
Submit the create show form
Open the edit show dialog from the show detail page
Fill "Edited Metadata Show" into the show name field
Save the show changes
Verify the updated show name "Edited Metadata Show" is visible on the show detail page

title: Create a custom task for a show
description: User can add a custom task with a title and optional due date and see it appear in the show task list.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a show card to open its detail page
Click the Tasks tab
Click Add Task to create a custom task
Fill Sample custom task into the task title field
Select a valid due date in the due date field
Submit the new task
Verify a task titled Sample custom task appears in the task list

title: Create an office task with full details
description: Verifies the user can create a new office task with details and it appears in the active task list.

steps.description: Navigate to /office-tasks
Open the create office task dialog
Fill Office Task 1 into the title field
Select a priority value
Select a status value
Select a valid due date into the due date field
Select a category value
Fill Short notes for Office Task 1 into the notes field
Submit the office task form
Verify a task with title Office Task 1 appears in the active tasks list

title: Mark a show task complete and update progress
description: User can toggle a task to complete and see the show progress indicator update accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a show card to open its detail page
Click the Tasks tab
Click Add Task to create a custom task
Fill Progress task into the task title field
Submit the new task
Toggle the completion checkbox for the task titled Progress task
Verify the task is shown as completed and the show progress indicator reflects increased completion

title: Validate required fields when creating a show
description: Verifies leaving required fields empty prevents show creation and keeps the create dialog open with validation feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to add a new show
Submit the create show form without filling required fields
Verify a required-field validation error is visible
Verify the create show dialog remains open

title: Create a custom e-blast with required fields
description: User can create a custom e-blast by filling required fields and see it appear in the list.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a show card to open its detail page
Click the E-Blasts tab
Start creating a custom e-blast
Fill Custom promo blast into the custom e-blast name or label field
Select a valid scheduled date for the custom e-blast
Submit the custom e-blast
Verify an e-blast entry for Custom promo blast appears in the e-blast list

title: Complete an office task and view it under completed
description: Verifies the user can mark a task complete and it appears in the completed section.

steps.description: Navigate to /office-tasks
Open the create office task dialog
Fill Office Task To Complete into the title field
Submit the office task form
Toggle completion for the task titled Office Task To Complete
Expand the completed tasks section
Verify a completed task with title Office Task To Complete is shown in the completed tasks list

title: Toggle an e-blast as sent
description: User can mark an e-blast as sent and the entry reflects sent status in the list.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a show card to open its detail page
Click the E-Blasts tab
Click a preset e-blast button to add a scheduled e-blast
Toggle the sent checkbox for the newly added e-blast
Verify the e-blast is shown as sent

title: Add a preset e-blast to a show
description: User can add a preset e-blast and see a new e-blast entry appear in the list.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a show card to open its detail page
Click the E-Blasts tab
Click a preset e-blast button to add a scheduled e-blast
Verify a new e-blast entry appears in the e-blast list

title: Add all preset e-blasts at once
description: User can add all preset e-blasts in one action and see multiple preset entries appear in the list.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a show card to open its detail page
Click the E-Blasts tab
Click Add All to add all preset e-blasts
Verify multiple preset e-blast entries are displayed in the e-blast list

title: Edit an existing office task
description: Verifies the user can edit an office task and the updated details are reflected in the task list.

steps.description: Navigate to /office-tasks
Open the create office task dialog
Fill Office Task To Edit into the title field
Submit the office task form
Open edit for the task titled Office Task To Edit
Fill Office Task Edited into the title field
Save the task changes
Verify a task with title Office Task Edited is visible in the tasks list

title: Add a preset task to a show
description: User can add a predefined preset task and see it appear in the show task list.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a show card to open its detail page
Click the Tasks tab
Click a preset task button to add a predefined task
Verify a new task item appears in the task list

title: View current month calendar with events rendered
description: Verifies the user can load the calendar view and see a monthly grid with events displayed for the current month.

steps.description: Navigate to /calendar
Verify the monthly calendar grid is displayed with event indicators or event entries visible

title: Navigate months to plan ahead and backtrack
description: Verifies the user can navigate to the next month and back to the previous month and the calendar updates accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /calendar
Click the next month navigation control
Click the previous month navigation control
Verify the calendar grid is updated to the original month view

title: Delete a show task
description: User can delete a task from the show and the task is removed from the list after confirming.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a show card to open its detail page
Click the Tasks tab
Click Add Task to create a custom task
Fill Delete me task into the task title field
Submit the new task
Click the trash icon for the task titled Delete me task
Confirm deletion
Verify the task titled Delete me task is no longer displayed in the task list

title: Filter office tasks using combined criteria
description: Verifies the user can apply multiple filters and the list updates to only tasks matching the selected criteria.

steps.description: Navigate to /office-tasks
Open the create office task dialog
Fill Filter Task A into the title field
Select a priority value
Select a status value
Select a category value
Submit the office task form
Set the status filter to the status used for Filter Task A
Set the priority filter to the priority used for Filter Task A
Set the category filter to the category used for Filter Task A
Verify the visible tasks match the selected filter criteria

title: Filter calendar events by a specific show
description: Verifies the user can filter the calendar to a specific show and only events for that show are shown.

steps.description: Navigate to /calendar
Select a specific show in the show filter dropdown
Click a day cell that has events
Verify the day side panel shows events for the selected show only

title: View show links list
description: User can open a show and view the Links tab with a visible list of saved links showing labels and URLs.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a show card to open its detail page
Click the Links tab
Verify a list of saved links is displayed with labels and URLs

title: Delete an office task from the list
description: Verifies the user can delete an office task and it is removed from the tasks list.

steps.description: Navigate to /office-tasks
Open the create office task dialog
Fill Office Task To Delete into the title field
Submit the office task form
Initiate delete for the task titled Office Task To Delete
Confirm deletion
Verify the task titled Office Task To Delete is not present in the tasks list

title: Delete an e-blast entry
description: User can delete an e-blast entry and it is removed from the list after confirming.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a show card to open its detail page
Click the E-Blasts tab
Click a preset e-blast button to add a scheduled e-blast
Click the trash icon for the newly added e-blast
Confirm deletion
Verify the deleted e-blast entry is no longer displayed in the e-blast list

title: Open a day to review detailed schedule
description: Verifies the user can open a day cell and see that day’s events listed in the side panel.

steps.description: Navigate to /calendar
Click a day cell in the month grid
Verify the day detail side panel is visible and shows a list of events for that day

title: Add a link to a show
description: User can add a labeled URL link to a show and see it appear in the links list.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a show card to open its detail page
Click the Links tab
Click Add Link to create a new link entry
Fill Exhibitor portal into the link label field
Fill https://example.com into the link URL field
Submit the new link
Verify a link labeled Exhibitor portal appears in the links list

title: Toggle an office task complete from the calendar day panel
description: Verifies the user can mark an office task complete directly from the day side panel and the task reflects completion.

steps.description: Navigate to /office-tasks
Open the create office task dialog
Fill Task A into the title field
Select a valid due date into the due date field
Submit the office task form
Click the navigation to the calendar view
Click the day cell matching the due date of Task A to open the side panel
Toggle completion for Task A from the side panel
Verify Task A is shown as completed in the day side panel

title: Search office tasks by title
description: Verifies the user can search by task title and only matching tasks remain visible.

steps.description: Navigate to /office-tasks
Open the create office task dialog
Fill Unique Search Task 123 into the title field
Submit the office task form
Fill Unique Search Task 123 into the search field
Verify the tasks list shows the task titled Unique Search Task 123

title: View and collapse archived shows section
description: Verifies the user can expand archived shows to view them and collapse the section again.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Expand the archived shows section
Collapse the archived shows section
Verify the archived shows section is collapsed

title: Sort office tasks by due date
description: Verifies the user can sort tasks by due date and the list order updates accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /office-tasks
Open the create office task dialog
Fill Sort Task 1 into the title field
Select a valid due date into the due date field
Submit the office task form
Open the create office task dialog
Fill Sort Task 2 into the title field
Select a different valid due date into the due date field
Submit the office task form
Select the sort option for due date
Verify the tasks list is reordered according to due date

title: Prevent creating a custom e-blast with missing required fields
description: User cannot submit a custom e-blast when required fields are missing and validation errors are shown.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a show card to open its detail page
Click the E-Blasts tab
Start creating a custom e-blast
Submit the custom e-blast without filling required fields
Verify required-field validation errors are visible for the custom e-blast form

title: Prevent creating a task without a title
description: User cannot submit a new custom task when the title is missing and a validation error is shown.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a show card to open its detail page
Click the Tasks tab
Click Add Task to create a custom task
Submit the new task without filling the task title
Verify a task title validation error is visible

title: Open a show link in a new browser tab
description: User can click a saved link and it opens in a new browser tab.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a show card to open its detail page
Click the Links tab
Click Add Link to create a new link entry
Fill External resource into the link label field
Fill https://example.com into the link URL field
Submit the new link
Click the link labeled External resource
Verify the link opens in a new browser tab

title: Delete a show link
description: User can delete a saved link and it is removed from the links list after confirming.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a show card to open its detail page
Click the Links tab
Click Add Link to create a new link entry
Fill Delete link into the link label field
Fill https://example.com into the link URL field
Submit the new link
Click the trash icon for the link labeled Delete link
Confirm deletion
Verify the link labeled Delete link is no longer displayed in the links list

title: Expand and collapse completed tasks section
description: Verifies the user can expand the completed section to view tasks and collapse it again.

steps.description: Navigate to /office-tasks
Expand the completed tasks section
Collapse the completed tasks section
Verify the completed tasks section is collapsed and completed tasks are not shown

title: Delete a show and confirm it is removed from the dashboard
description: Verifies deleting a show from its detail page removes it from the dashboard list after confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to add a new show
Fill "Delete Me Show" into the show name field
Fill a valid move-in date into the move-in date field
Submit the create show form
Initiate deleting the show from the show detail page
Confirm the deletion
Navigate to /
Verify the show named "Delete Me Show" is not present in the show list

title: Prevent adding a link with an invalid URL
description: User cannot submit a new link when the URL is invalid and a URL validation error is shown.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a show card to open its detail page
Click the Links tab
Click Add Link to create a new link entry
Fill Bad URL into the link label field
Fill not-a-url into the link URL field
Submit the new link
Verify a URL validation error is visible

title: Manage sticky notes locally within the session
description: Verifies the user can add, edit, recolor, and delete a sticky note and the sidebar reflects each change.

steps.description: Navigate to /office-tasks
Add a new sticky note
Fill Sticky Note A into the sticky note text area
Change the sticky note color to a different available color
Delete the sticky note
Verify the sticky note is no longer shown in the sticky notes sidebar
